objective: Implement the IRIS Core Phase 0 graduation-readiness controller that fail-closed binds the existing executable-worker candidate stage to independent IRIS review, checkpoint-first delivery, governed merge, canonical-main equality, rollback evidence, cleanup, and provider-authoritative zero-resource verification; correct stale completed-graduation self-description and read-model claims without performing the final graduation.
completion_mandate_text: Founder mandate: finish the cycle to completion with Codex and Claude working together, fix bounded problems as they arise, avoid needless delays, and finish this. Ordinary exact-path staging, commit, non-force branch push, pull request, independent review, merge, synchronization, and cleanup are bundled; protected effects remain excluded.
completion_exclusions: Dependency version or lockfile changes and lifecycle-script execution
Credentials, provider mutation, deployment, public or LAN exposure, spending, or paid resources
Repository administration, visibility, ruleset, branch-protection, secret, variable, or access changes
permitted_actions: Read canonical sources and verified provider state
Edit only the allowed IRIS Core paths
Materialize the exact frozen lockfile offline with lifecycle scripts disabled inside a disposable verification copy
Run focused and full local verification
Repair failures within the same bounded design
Prepare an exact handoff for independent review
Stage and commit only the exact allowed paths after independent review passes
Push the bounded branch without force, create and review its pull request, merge only if checks pass, synchronize main, and remove only disposable Cycle Nine artifacts
prohibited_actions: Perform or simulate completion of the final Phase 0 graduation
Mutate the Founder Command Center worktree
Install or update dependency versions, edit a lockfile, or execute dependency lifecycle scripts
Force-push, rewrite history, or delete canonical evidence
required_evidence: Exact base revision and clean worktree verification
Fail-closed approval, actor, model, checkpoint, review, merge, equality, rollback, cleanup, and provider-zero tests
Exact changed-path list and rollback instructions
Independent review of the exact producer result before publication; the producer cannot approve its own material result
Claude, Codex, IRIS, and worker instructions share the same explicit definition of canonical authority and operating virtues
